segments.text: FIrst, It will torment them to think of the greatness of the Glory which they have lost. O if it had been that which they could have spared, it had been a small matter: or If it had been a losse repairable with any thing else; If it had been health, or wealth, or friends, or life, it had been nothing; But to lose that exceeding Eternall weight of Glory! —
